name: com.mayamate/claimtrace
title: ClaimTrace
description: Check every number in an AI-written document against its source, with the source span.

tools.name: check_numbers
tools.description: Check every number in an AI-written document against its sources. Each source is a URL (http:// or https://) or pasted source text; at most 3. Returns a one-line summary and the claim ledger: each numeric claim labelled SUPPORTED, MISMATCH or UNSUPPORTED with the source span. Set share=true for a public report link (kept 30 days).
